title: Show off
tagline: Show Off is social AR mobile app that brings your crypto assets to life. Visualize and interact with your crypto tokens and NFTs in an AR environment. Share your AR experiences using the Lens Protocol and join friends
description: "Show Off" is a cutting-edge Social-AR mobile app that brings crypto assets to life in the real world. Users can visualize and interact with their crypto tokens and NFTs in an immersive AR experience. The app supports multiple blockchain networks and integrated with protocols like Chainlink and Lens. Users can record videos of their AR interactions and share that on hey (Lenster).
how_its_made: On the frontend, we use React Native for cross-platform mobile development and viro-react for AR features, complemented by Wagmi for wallet connection and react-native-paper for the UI. The backend is powered by Node.js and Express, with Web3.js and Moralis handling blockchain interactions and token fetching, and Alchemy for NFT retrieval. Cloudinary manages video storage and link generation, securely storing these links on zkSync Era mainnet and Polygon zkEVM Cardano testnet. We utilize Chainlink for real-time crypto price feeds, fetching ENS handle from wagmi and Lens Protocol for social sharing and handle integration, creating a cohesive, cutting-edge AR platform.
